selection.ownership: SupportBee Inc., Covina, California, United States (CEO Prateek Dayal; founded 2010). The reviewed edition is the public international REST API at https://<company>.supportbee.com, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official SupportBee API (Bearer token, Accept application/json, https://{company}.supportbee.com, GET /users, GET /tickets, GET /tickets/{id}, GET /labels, GET /teams, HTTP 403 Access Denied), SupportBee Inc. California identity, security page, and dated incident search for SupportBee / SupportBee Inc / supportbee.com security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official SupportBee REST API with Bearer auth and per-desk https://{company}.supportbee.com host reviewed on 2026-09-13. Operator is SupportBee Inc., California. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of SupportBee / SupportBee Inc / supportbee.com security breach coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
